title: Refactor C# Tests to Load Data from Shared JSON Assets
description: Refactor the C# test file at semio/net/Semio.Tests/Tests.cs to load hardcoded test data (GUIDs, design names, expected values, hash strings, glob patterns) from shared JSON asset files in semio/assets/semio/. Test behavior stays in C#, only data moves to assets. Affects: HashTests, DesignQualitySum, KitFilterDesign, FindReplaceableTypesInDesignsTests, Flatten classes.
summary:
Refactored 5 C# test classes in semio/net/Semio.Tests/Tests.cs to load hardcoded test data from shared JSON asset files in semio/assets/semio/. All test behavior remains in C#; only data (kit filenames, design names, piece names, expected hashes, glob patterns, tolerance values) now comes from assets via JObject.Parse.

1. **Flatten** (5 tests) - Design paths loaded from flatten.cases.semio.json via LoadFlattenCases() helper.
2. **DesignQualitySum** (1 test) - Design name, quality name, expected value, tolerance loaded from quality-sum.cases.semio.json.
3. **KitFilterDesign** (6 tests) - Kit filenames, design names, glob patterns, expected kit filenames loaded from filter-kit.cases.semio.json via LoadFilterKitAsset() helper.
4. **HashTests** (2 tests modified) - Kit filename, expected hashes (including NET48 variant), kit diff canonical hash loaded from hash.cases.semio.json via LoadHashAsset() helper.
5. **FindReplaceableTypesInDesignsTests** (6 tests) - Kit filenames, design names, piece names, design parent names, piece indices, lookup type names, forbidden type names, selection asset filenames, expected counts loaded from find-replaceable-types.cases.semio.json via LoadFindReplaceableAsset() helper. Design/type GUID equality assertions kept only where asset values match C# implementation output (Go and C# return different results for FindReplaceable).

All 82 net8.0 tests pass.
